title: Large Reasoning Models Are (Not Yet) Multilingual Latent Reasoners

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring cross-lingual disparities in latent reasoning capacity using reasoning-trace truncation metrics (AUTC, AUGC, LRS) across 11 languages of varying resource levels, and evaluating English-centric representation bias by analyzing layer-wise answer emergence (via logit lens) and computing the cosine similarity of hidden states between target languages and English.
